headline: CrowdStrike Announces $100,000 International AI Security Challenge
summary: AUSTIN, Texas, August 05, 2026--CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced AI Unlocked: Agents of Chaos, a $100,000 AI security challenge in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this virtual game, players use prompt injection and other techniques to manipulate AI agents weaponized by a fictional adversary and stop them before they strike, learning firsthand how agents can be exploited in enterprise environments and what it takes to secure them.
